senses.sense_definition: A type of curve formed by the intersection of a cone and a plane, where every point on the curve is the same distance from a fixed point and a fixed line.

examples.text: The path of a ball thrown into the air follows a <w>parabola</w> until it hits the ground.
Engineers calculated the <w>parabola</w> of the satellite dish to ensure it could receive signals.

senses.sense_definition: A simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson.

examples.text: The teacher shared a <w>parabola</w> to help the students understand the importance of kindness.
Ancient texts often use a <w>parabola</w> to convey complex philosophical truths in a simple way.

traits.comment: This usage is rare and considered archaic compared to the standard term.
